description: This file defines the ValidationPipelineBehavior class, which acts as a MediatR pipeline behavior to validate requests using FluentValidation validators before handling the request.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A MediatR pipeline behavior that validates requests using FluentValidation before passing them to the next handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Validates the request using registered validators; throws ValidationException if validation fails; otherwise proceeds to the next handler.
